answer: Each identity holds one priced slot sealed with a cipher commitment. Each epoch it pays 5% of its price as tax, and a comet window lets any agent buy any slot at its posted price. A 500-credit slot pays 25 per epoch, so 1,000 fakes pay 25,000; priced low, comet buyers sweep them, and rebuilding costs 70 each. A cipher seal mismatch burns the bond. Ten honest epochs earn relic status, halving the tax; an honest agent pays 25 and keeps its slot.
